slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Helping a recruitment agency build a stronger security culture

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Employees faced increasingly convincing cyber threats. High email volumes made it difficult for staff to distinguish genuine messages from fraudulent ones. Although technical controls were in place, management recognised that improving employee awareness was essential to reducing human error.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: We reviewed the agency’s daily working practices before delivering tailored awareness sessions covering phishing, password security, social engineering and secure handling of confidential information. Real examples helped employees understand how modern attacks work and how to respond safely.

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: Employees became more confident identifying suspicious emails, phishing reports increased by around 30% and management saw more consistent security behaviour across every department.
